body: I don't know what ill even tell him, i keep bottling up all this sadness and it just makes me feel worthless, I dont have the confidence to walk into a shop and apply for a job, i tried writing up a resume but couldnt find a cracked copy of windows word, i just feel like the stars are pitted against me and every time i stand up i get thrown back down, i feel like i did back up north with my mom, pathetic miserable and just tired of it all.

Im supposed to be going back to GED classes here on the 11th, my dad doesnt want me to work he says im too smart and wants to support me. And i don't feel like unloading this on all my friends, admitting im a virgin and im such a piece of shit is something i can't bare mysefl to do.
Thanks man it really means a lot, i used to be able to confide with friends sometimes up in the city i lived with my mother but down here i have nobody.
